title: רב יהודה חמוהי דרב סלא חסידא

paragraphs: Rav Yehudah, “father-in-law of Rav Sala the Pious,” should read brother of Rav Sala the Pious, as at the beginning of Elu Kesharim and Yoma 19b. He entered Rav Huna's presence when four hundred jars of Rav Huna’s wine soured. Some say the visitor was Rav Adda bar Ahavah: Berakhot 5b. Elijah told him, “Do not become angry; do not become intoxicated; and do not sin”: Berakhot 29b. Elijah told him the world would have no fewer than eighty-five jubilees and in the last jubilee the son of David would come: Chelek, Sanhedrin 97b. See also Yoma there [a different conversation about the Messiah with the same participants].
